description.value: Earnest Ice Cream is a Vancouver-area institution founded in 2012, crafting small-batch ice cream from local and seasonal ingredients across four scoop shops — including this North Vancouver location on West 1st Street. The company is notable for rotating monthly flavours, a range of vegan options, and a genuine sustainability commitment that includes carbon-neutral operations and a returnable glass jar pint program. A touring cyclist seeking a quality sweet stop in North Van will find both indoor and outdoor seating here.

The FAQs and events pages confirm vegan flavour options (coconut milk/oat milk bases) and takeout sales (scoops in cones/cups, pints to go). enrichment_extras.notes: The business has three other Vancouver locations (Fraser St, Quebec St, Frances St); this record covers only the North Van shop. The strong sustainability narrative (zero waste, returnable jars, carbon neutral) may be of interest to values-aligned cycling tourists.

Packed lunches.detail: Menu is ice cream only — scoops, pints, sundaes, and sandwiches; no savoury food offered

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website FAQs explicitly describe vegan flavours (dairy, egg, and honey free) using coconut milk, oat milk, and house-made nut milk bases. Site notes it is not a gluten-free facility
